files.exact_claim: Atom.Updated At{:1}: [datetime]{:1}; Atom.Updated At.*[]{:0}; Atom//$atom.Updated At == MAX(Event Record//(.object_output{=1}, .object_output.version{=1}, .object_output.id = $atom.ID, .object_output.version = $atom.Version, (.action = create OR .action = update)).happened_at)

Projection.Updated At{:1}: [datetime]{:1}; Projection.Updated At.*[]{:0}; Projection//$projection.Updated At == MAX(Event Record//(.object_output{=1}, .object_output.version{=0}, .object_output.id = $projection.ID, (.action = create OR .action = update)).happened_at)

files.change: Clarifies left-to-right short-circuit evaluation for filter conditions and AND groups, while evaluated invalid values remain errors.

model_cases.record_outputs: Matching Atom output id/version at accepted create 09:00Z and update 10:00Z.
id A/version 2 at 11:00Z, id A/version 3 at 12:00Z; selected Atom is A/version 3.

model_cases.expected: It matches Projection after output and version-absence guards.

model_cases.record_outputs: Output has id P and version 1.

model_cases.record_outputs: No-op, failed, archive, and carrier-only actions do not create accepted create/update records.

model_cases.record_outputs: Output/version guards hold but id or version is invalid or unresolved.

preserved_boundaries: Updated At scalar datetime/no-children contracts stay first in both Claims.
Event Record.happened_at, not inserted_at or output.updated_at, is the aggregate source.

verification: Both Claims contain no prose and reference lowercase .action.
